_comment: Scene for whole.mp4 (1440x1440 -> 512x512, fixed overhead camera). Pixel coords (x, y), origin top-left. The occluder includes the upright at the plank's top end. Ball is blue with yellow/green/white stripes; wood is H 5-20, so stripes are H 22+. Unset keys use robust_world.scene.DEFAULTS.
_hand_comment: Ball-coloured pixels are removed from the hand mask, so fingertips at the frame edge (about 1000 px) are caught while the ball's own edge (300 px or less) is not.
_segments_comment: Ball rolled in from the right until the last right pass at 1705.2s, and from the left from 1711.5s. A clip's whole window must lie inside its segment, so right and left share no frames. Right is for training/eval now; left is held out for testing later.
